source: Memory_Tech_Comparison.xlsx plus SCOPE v3-v7 equations and 2024-2025 OSFET BTI measurements

semantics.osfet_bti: Vth,max=70 mV defines equivalent retention. A 2024 VLSI ITO:F measurement anchors Delta-Vth at 18 mV after 1 ks, a 2025 oxide-TFT fit supplies beta/tau, and an Arrhenius plus E-model stress corner maps the reference data to hot-cache operation. Periodic row read+rewrite contributes bandwidth occupancy and refresh power.
semantics.bti_scope: Cross-device behavior-level projection, not a direct lifetime claim for one fabricated OSFET-eDRAM macro. The 368 K/5 MV-per-cm corner is deliberately pessimistic; the field coefficient is a disclosed SCOPE calibration parameter.

refresh.maintenance_action: row read followed by rewrite/recovery before Delta-Vth reaches 70 mV
